prompt: State how the acceleration of an object can be determined from its velocity-time graph.

mark_scheme.criterion: gradient of the line (or gradient of the tangent to the curve)

hints: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity.
Rate of change on a graph corresponds to slope or gradient.
solution: The acceleration is determined from the gradient of the velocity-time graph (or the gradient of the tangent to the curve).
teacher_walkthrough: Acceleration is Delta v / Delta t, so acceleration equals the gradient.
